summary: Iteration 2 regression after Render-prep changes. Backend (pytest against http://localhost:8001): 42 passed, 2 skipped (cookie-over-http env limitation), 0 failed. NEW tests added: /health returns {status:ok}; /api/ returns status ok; /api/payments/config returns mode=simulation & live=false; /api/payments/papi/notification without X-Papi-Signature returns 401; legacy /payments/mvola|orange endpoints correctly removed (404/405). Brute-force lockout fix from previous iteration is confirmed: identifier is now email-based and test_5_wrong_attempts_lock passes (returns 429). E-commerce e2e in simulation: create order (MVola) -> initiate -> pending -> completed (~10s) -> order.status=paid. Admin: orders list/filter/patch/delete, stats, CSV export, status toggle (restored to online), products CRUD, events CRUD+like all pass. Frontend (localhost:3000 with playwright route proxy rewriting external /api to localhost:8001 because external ingress currently 404s all /api/*): all listed routes load without JS errors, boutique shows 22 products, product page, add to cart, checkout MVola with pubg id/pseudo/phone submits, simulation-notice testid IS present in PaymentStatus card (regression fix from iter_1), payment auto-completes to 'Paiement confirmé !' with MGS-XXXXXX order number in ~10-11s. /compte and /admin correctly redirect to /connexion when unauthenticated. /connexion shows the Google button. Note: deeper Admin UI testing blocked by the proxy not being able to forward Set-Cookie via Playwright route.fulfill; backend admin login itself works (verified via pytest and login POST body).
environment_issue: External preview URL https://store-audit-build.preview.emergentagent.com/api/* returns 404 from the K8s ingress (platform 'wake servers' state). Because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to that external URL, real users hitting the deployed frontend cannot reach the backend from the browser. Health at root (/health) DOES return 200 via ingress, only /api/* is 404. This is a platform/infra issue, NOT an app bug. Local backend (http://localhost:8001) is fully healthy.

minor.issue: Simulated auto-complete observed ~10s (spec says ~8s). Acceptable — the frontend polls at 3s intervals and the UI reliably shows 'Paiement confirmé' within 10-12s.

Cookies are set with Secure=true and SameSite=None. Correct for prod HTTPS but means cookie-based auth cannot be exercised over plain http://localhost. Two pytest cases (me_with_cookie, logout_clears_cookies) are conditionally skipped when BASE_URL is http. Bearer-token auth over http works normally.

integration_issues.flow: Any browser->backend call in preview env
integration_issues.issue: External ingress returns 404 for /api/* → all frontend API calls fail without a proxy. See environment_issue field. Not an app bug.

issues: Radix a11y warning still present: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — carry-over minor from iter_1.

action_items: PLATFORM/INFRA: Restore /api/* routing on the preview ingress (or wake the preview) so browser calls from the deployed frontend succeed. Root URL (/) and /health both work; only /api/* is 404 at ingress. Confirm this is fine for the Render deployment target (Render will route through its own ingress).
MINOR (a11y): Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to shadcn Dialog usages (cart drawer, admin product dialog, admin event dialog).
OPTIONAL: Reduce simulated payment delay slightly (currently ~10s vs spec ~8s) if desired for a snappier UX.
critical_code_review_comments: Deployment prep is clean: /health at root (not /api) confirmed responding 200 {status:ok}; /api/ root also 200. Good.

backend/routers/payments.py: /config now reads os.environ.get for merchant numbers (no crash if unset), and papi notificationUrl is built from _backend_url(request) which honors BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL/RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL then request.base_url — good for reverse-proxy deploys.
backend/routers/auth.py brute-force lockout is now keyed on email (per-account); the previously reported proxy-IP bug is fixed.
backend/routers/payments.py papi_notification correctly returns 401 for missing/invalid X-Papi-Signature and does not leak on unknown references (returns 401).
Cookies remain Secure+SameSite=None everywhere — correct for cross-site HTTPS deployments; ensure the Render deployment terminates TLS.

requirements.txt is slimmed and PAYMENT_MODE=simulation is committed in backend/.env for the preview env; make sure the Render env sets PAYMENT_MODE=papi (or unset default) with PAPI_API_KEY / PAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET at deploy time.
Simulation notice testid ('simulation-notice') is now correctly rendered inside PaymentStatus waiting card — regression fix from iter_1 verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — added TestHealth (health/root), payments_config, papi_notification_unsigned_401, converted legacy mvola/orange callback tests to 'removed' assertions, conditional pytest.skip for cookie-based tests on http BASE_URL, and probe-based BASE_URL fallback to localhost when external /api is 404.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical customer flows validated via proxy (home, boutique with 22 products, product page, cart, MVola checkout end-to-end with simulated confirmation and order number, redirects, Google button)

test_credentials: Admin admin@magicgame.store / Admin@2026! confirmed via pytest login. Guests QA created ad-hoc during tests.
seed_data_creation: Test-created guest/customer orders and one authed customer remain in DB (QA/qa_ prefixed, small volume). Ephemeral product/event created via admin CRUD tests are deleted at end of each test. Admin online status restored to true at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green against localhost:8001 (see /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py). External ingress 404 for /api/* is a platform state, not an app bug — verify via curl before spending time on it. When testing the frontend in the preview env, use a Playwright route interceptor to rewrite https://store-audit-build.preview.emergentagent.com/api/* to http://localhost:8001 (see script pattern used here); note that Set-Cookie cannot be reliably forwarded through route.fulfill so cookie-only auth flows (e.g., /admin protected UI) look broken through the proxy — this is a proxy artifact only. Simulation payment latency ~10s.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs this iteration. The two pytest skips are due to python-requests refusing to send Secure cookies over http://localhost (correct browser-like behavior), verified independently via curl -H 'Cookie:' which returns 200 on /api/auth/me. The frontend-through-proxy admin redirect is due to Playwright route.fulfill not preserving Set-Cookie headers; not a product bug.
